# SimpleFOC Mini v1.0 — vendor board file

`PCB_simplefocmini_2022-04-20.json` is the EasyEDA PCB export of the
**SimpleFOC Mini v1.0** (DRV8313) module, from the upstream project:

* <https://github.com/simplefoc/SimpleFOCMini>
* <https://easyeda.com/the.skuric/simplefocmini>
* MIT licence — see `LICENSE` (Copyright (c) 2022 SimpleFOCproject)

It is committed here because the carrier's socket footprint is **derived from
it at build time**, not transcribed by hand. `tools/gen_kicad.py` reads this
file and produces `hardware/kicad/lib/canfoc.pretty/SimpleFOC_Mini_Socket.kicad_mod`:

| From the file | Used for |
|---|---|
| header `H1` pads 1–10 | socket pads 1–10 (2×5, 2.54 mm) |
| header `P1` pads 1–3 | socket pads 11–13 = OUT3, OUT2, OUT1 |
| board-outline tracks (EasyEDA layer 10) | silkscreen and courtyard |

Coordinates are EasyEDA internal units, 1 unit = 0.254 mm (confirmed by the
2.54 mm header pitch). The footprint origin is H1 pad 1.

Measured from this file, the module is **23.0 × 21.0 mm** and its outline runs
x −13.72 … +9.29 mm, y −1.91 … +19.05 mm about that origin — it reaches
9.3 mm past pad 1 on the screw-terminal side, which is the clearance that
matters when placing it on the carrier. It has **no mounting holes**.

Do not edit this file. To track a new revision of the module, replace it and
re-run `python3 tools/gen_kicad.py`.
